newsitem.title: USA: US Commerce sees exports continuing to grow.
newsitem.headline: US Commerce sees exports continuing to grow.

text.p: U.S. exports should continue to grow from a record level of $73 billion in February, despite the higher value of the dollar relative to other currencies, Commerce Secretary William Daley said on Thursday.

"The numbers that we've seen this month will continue to be duplicated in the months ahead as far as continued growth in our exports," Daley said at a news briefing here in response to a question about the stronger dollar's impact.
U.S. exports rose four percent in February to a record $73.46 billion, the Commerce Department reported earlier. Imports rose 2.1 percent to a record $85.05 billion for the month, Commerce reported.
